title: git apply onto a test path is refused only at commit, not at write
why: A builder ran git apply on a patch that touches a test path. The write went through, and only the commit-time diff check refused it. That left hooks/mutate_guard.py half-applied in the worktree.
source: coordinator 18:57 CST Nov 12, from lane record-before-fix-push (session_013NEJL419X64MWpu8fiDyB7), #2979
note: Fix: the write-time test-path guard reads the file list of a git apply patch (git apply --numstat) and refuses before it writes, as it already does for Edit and Write. Test red on main first. Lane 20:16 CST Nov 12: review round 1 FAIL. Lane pick (reversible, not an owner ruling): a patch that the same command writes (heredoc, tee or redirect, then git apply) is judged like a same-command script, not as "missing". For the debt store: git apply inside $(...) or backticks; `git -C "$VAR" apply`; a `<<-` tab-indented heredoc. Notes: an --exclude false alarm; _apply_root and _APPLY_REDIRECT copy repo_root and REDIRECTION (one-home-per-capability). The lane writes them as debts or notes per roles-findings-are-debts-or-notes.
